verdict.rationale: Databricks is offered exclusively as a managed cloud service (AWS/Azure/GCP workspaces, pay-as-you-go billing) with no documented option to self-host the core platform on your own infrastructure; the closest analog (Free Edition) is still a hosted SaaS trial, not a self-hostable deployment. Community evidence even references how self-hosting Spark used to be painful specifically because Databricks replaced that with a hosted service, reinforcing that the core product is not self-hostable.
